description: Defines the CubicBytes class implementing the TCP Cubic congestion control algorithm, including methods for calculating congestion window adjustments after packet loss and ACKs, and managing cubic algorithm state.

classes.name: quic::CubicBytes
classes.description: Helper class implementing TCP Cubic congestion control algorithm, managing congestion window adjustments based on network conditions.

methods.name: CubicBytes
methods.description: Constructor initializing CubicBytes with a given clock.

methods.name: SetNumConnections
methods.description: Sets the number of connections to simulate for congestion control calculations.

methods.name: ResetCubicState
methods.description: Resets the cubic congestion control state after a timeout.

methods.name: CongestionWindowAfterPacketLoss
methods.description: Calculates new congestion window after packet loss event.

methods.name: CongestionWindowAfterAck
methods.description: Calculates new congestion window after receiving an ACK.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Resets cubic state when sender is application-limited.

methods.name: Alpha
methods.description: Computes the TCP Cubic alpha parameter based on current connections.

methods.name: Beta
methods.description: Computes the TCP Cubic beta parameter based on current connections.

methods.name: BetaLastMax
methods.description: Computes the beta-last-max parameter based on current connections.
